finding: Family is a shared root with a 3-stage ladder; my tally over 397 evolution pairs gives about x2.12 hp and x2.28 atk from stage 1 to 2, about x1.65 and x1.85 from 2 to 3 (app/models/colyseus-models/pokemon.ts, class fields).

Variant byte packs a shiny bit and a 7-bit emotion index (20 emotion slots) into one uint8; default is zero and not sent (app/models/colyseus-models/pokemon-customs.ts line 19; app/types/enum/Emotion.ts line 41).

Per-species attack motion table: 30 basic-attack types, 54 ability types, 39 attack-sprite keys (element plus melee or range), 18 hit-sprite keys (app/public/src/game/components/pokemon-animations.ts; app/types/Animation.ts).
Top stage can drop the family's signature skill to the default (app/models/colyseus-models/pokemon.ts lines 466-467); a design to avoid for us.

PvE bosses are existing creatures on small boards with an emotion tint, a statBoosts block (hp up to +200 on the last stage) and held items; 11 stage entries (app/models/pve-stages.ts lines 42 and 343).
Synergy tiers are count thresholds (for example 2,4,6,8 or 3,5,7,9) over 31 synergy rows (app/config/game/synergies.ts lines 6-178, 179 on).
Licence: code GPL v3; README says all rights to The Pokemon Company, so creature identity is category-level inspiration only (README.md line 5; LICENSE line 1).
Family key is the genus field: 255 of 689 monster yaml files carry one, 55 distinct values; 434 files are standalone (dat/mons/*.yaml).

Draconian 8-colour family shares hit dice 14 and hp_10x 980 and swaps one resist per colour, one damage step (grey 25) and one wing flag (black) (dat/mons/*-draconian.yaml; black-draconian.yaml line 4).
Serpent boss has 4 variants with one stat block (hp_10x 3230) that swap bite element, resists and spell list (dat/mons/serpent-of-hell*.yaml; serpent-of-hell-dis.yaml line 20).
Derived undead: a dying creature can leave a prefix-named copy of its body (mon-death.cc line 1551; mon-flags.h line 288 MF_NAME_ZOMBIE; M_NO_GEN_DERIVED on 38 files).

Population is a depth-banded weighted table of rows {min depth, max depth, weight, shape, monster}; 1,062 rows matched (mon-pick-data.h; shape FLAT 532, FALL 174, SEMI 152, RISE 108, PEAK 96). Curve code not read.
Uniques carry a unique flag (99 files) and 17 use a taller frame (tall_tile; mon-flags.h line 140).
